svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given a beat whose harvest holds each value it proved and the state it left; beat 1: its row renders → the proof cell is already looping — no media mode to pick, no play to press — opening on the When in motion, not on the state the Given row already showed, framed tight on the thing being proven, with the whole frame exactly one toggle away; beat 2: you switch the reader's play control from auto to step → every loop holds where it is, and a click on a proof cell advances that beat one scene — the drawing beside it moving with it, wrapping at the end; beat 3: the row is the Given → its one frame stays a still: a state, not an action
